scope_assessment: No material formula, axis, donor-unit, subset-enumeration or source-selection leakage problem detected in this frozen descriptive audit. Its control-based selection assumes all controls already measured; no equal-total-budget or unseen-perturbation claim. Oracle is correctly nondeployable. Three donors and one stimulus only support E1 measured-panel description.
important_limitations: Cultures are averaged within donor before donor bootstrap; sensitivity does not separately model nested culture noise.
All nine sources increase measurements; negative edges apply to equal averaging and cannot identify intrinsically harmful species.
Native annotation/mapping and taxon/reference differences remain coupled with biology.
Every performance-ranked best subset uses observed target outcomes and is an oracle.
